name: Littoral-Bajada
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by bioluminescent seas. Beyond a nearby asteroid belt, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
Established during the last boom, the smuggler cache was never decommissioned. Its roster lists eleven souls; life-support draws power for thirty.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
